caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the coherency levels of four categories labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4. The categories are displayed on the horizontal axis, which is labeled with the category names in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the coherency percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 86 to 100, marked at intervals of two. Each bar is presented using a distinct color: V1 is blue, V2 is orange, V3 is green, and V4 is purple. The heights of the bars indicate their respective coherency values, with V1 approximately at 93.69%, V2 at 93.8%, V3 at 94.5%, and V4 at 91.1%. The bars appear to be sorted neither by size nor alphabetically, and none of them are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation beyond their color differentiation.
